title: Excel Interview Sheet Upload & Duplicate Safety
tagline: Multi-sheet interview charts ko bina kisi error ke upload karein
steps: 1. Left menu se **Joining Process** page par jayein.
2. **'Choose Spreadsheet'** button dabakar apni Interview Excel file (.xlsx) select karein.
3. System file ke sabhi sheets (e.g. UP, Bihar, Maharashtra) aur batches ko automatically scan kar leta hai.
4. Agar koi candidate dubara upload hota hai, to system **Duplicate Review Screen** dikhayega: wahan aap **'Keep Existing'** (purana record safe rakhein) ya **'Replace'** chun sakte hain.
pro_tip: 💡 Tip: Agar Excel me koi optional column miss ho, to bhi system rukta nahi hai aur baaki saara data process kar leta hai.

title: Review & Dispatch Welcome Emails
tagline: Selected candidates ko 1-click me personalized selection confirmation bhejein
steps: 1. Joining Process page me **'Selected'** filter tab par click karein.
2. Jin candidates ko email bhejna hai, unke aage wale checkboxes ko tick karein.
3. Top toolbar par **'✉️ Review & Send Welcome Emails'** button dabayein.
4. Preview modal me email subject aur body check karein (Candidate ka naam, post aur location automatically personalize ho jate hain), fir **'Send'** dabayein.
pro_tip: 💡 Tip: Welcome email bhejne ke baad candidate ke aage green **'Sent'** badge lag jata hai.

title: Smart Document Generator & Final Go
tagline: Offer Letters, Increments aur Relieving Certificates bina serial number kharab kiye draft karein
steps: 1. Left menu se **Document Generator** page par jayein.
2. **Tab 1 (Smart Detector)**: System automatically pehchan leta hai kis staff ko konsa letter chahiye (Offer, Extension, Increment, Relieving). Candidate chunein aur **'Draft to Staging'** dabayein.
3. **Tab 2 (Staging & Final Review)**: Yahan draft document ko preview karein, zaroorat ho to salary ya posting location turant inline edit karein (turant re-generate ho jata hai).
4. Sab theek lagne par **'🚀 Final Go: Dispatch Selected'** dabayein. Official sequence number usi waqt consume hota hai aur email dispatch ho jata hai.
pro_tip: 💡 Tip: Draft banate waqt official reference number consume nahi hota, isliye sequencing hamesha clean rehti hai.

title: Keka HRMS Sync & Employee Number Assignment
tagline: Joined employees ko unka official Keka Employee ID assign karein
steps: 1. Keka portal se employee master export sheet download karein.
2. Left menu se **Keka Sync** page par jayein aur **'Choose Keka Sheet'** dabayein.
3. System duplicate check karega aur agar pehle se employee exist karta hai to safe update option dega.
4. Sync complete hote hi sabhi joined staff ke profile me Keka ID aur statutory details map ho jayenge.
pro_tip: 💡 Tip: Dashboard par Keka sync ka live green pill dikhta hai jab sabhi joined staff synced hote hain.

title: Official DFY HR Manual (Updated 2025) Guidelines
tagline: DFY ke sabhi 10 Articles ka authentic operational guide
steps: • **Working Hours (Art. 4)**: Mon to Sat subah 9:30 AM se shaam 5:30 PM (48 hrs/week).
• **Probation (Art. 2)**: Har naye employee ka probation review hona mandatory hai.
• **Leaves (Art. 4)**: Casual Leave aur Sick Leave supervisor ki approval se milti hain. Maternity leave female staff ke liye uplabdh hai.
• **Notice Period (Art. 5)**: Resignation par notice period serve karna aur no-dues clear hone par hi Relieving Certificate issue hota hai.
• **Medical Insurance (Art. 6)**: Eligible employees ko Group Health Insurance cover milta hai.
pro_tip: 💡 Tip: Dashboard par search bar me kisi bhi rule ke bare me type karein, system instant reference dega.
